**Performance: PASS WITH NOTES** at `ac95e5325f001e4b0c72c638a0e170078e2a406e`, round 2 (final under C34).

The shared `native_supersedes` resolver now covers the retired-session/old-ID path as well as an explicit predecessor. Both matched holder-current refusals return before host proof: **zero native process observations/ps**. The new regression makes three inferred-holder refusals with a zero observer count, then gives the old session a newer prompt and positively verifies process observation before takeover. This is not a uniform-negative-only test.

**Important revision to the round-1 cost budget:** the early brake replaces its predecessor PK lookup with **a full registry list plus schema guard** for each precedence-bearing registration that passes the initial checks. It decodes historical rows too, retains an O(S) vector, and runs a constant number of linear candidate-selection passes. This applies to non-standby attempts reaching the brake, not just refusals.

A matched refusal still skips later proof/dead-owner/admission work. A candidate that continues pays the new pre-proof snapshot in addition to the existing later reads. The locked resolver reuses its already-read snapshot, but the early snapshot is not reused across those phases. **Zero process reads does not mean zero store/CPU work.**

**P222-N001 / C34 follow-up:** this full-catalog pre-proof cost supersedes the earlier PK-only description and matters to the CPU investigation. No deployed timing/row-allocation ceiling or normal-use cost breach is established here, so it is not a block or a request for speculative redesign.

The extension's three-refusal/30s-to600s policy, prompt/live-resume re-arm, successful-registration reset and cancellation cleanup are unchanged from round1. No new timer, loop cadence or launch site; timed checks still scale with standby sessions. After-deploy proof must measure both eliminated ps and remaining in-process work.

**Exact-head CI:** [42767043953](https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/actions/runs/42767043953), Rust job `129665864723`, successful-upload artifact **13740012315**, matching trigger-head metadata: **2,415 executed passed**, zero failures/errors; six skips separately reported by nextest. JUnit names the inferred-holder zero-read/positive-takeover regression; all six spawn guards execute. Node22/24, Rust lint and final delivers succeed; worktree clean and matching GitHub head/CLEAN.

No local product build/test, synthetic standby traffic, live reload or daemon change. The PID45657 paired baseline is pre-deploy; **#222's after-reading remains owed**.
